scope: bounded supervision proof after structured MATCH claim FAIL; no unified fitting
candidate_selection: per video first8 identities by actual first stale-bank READ, choose last online WRITE before that READ; plus2 late writes for identities never read. Enriched read-eligible diagnostic, not an unbiased tie prevalence estimate. No GT in sampling.
read_definition: identity outside active association window, present in stale bank, included in actual GMT reactivation score computation
future_policy: frozen B2 MATCH, instantaneous GMT MEMORY and REACT except current WRITE/SKIP intervention; every future state and proposal rebuilt
event_horizon: candidate WRITE branch until its first actual stale-bank READ +16 frames, or sequence end; SKIP branch follows the same paired end. Compare common window at first WRITE READ +8/+16. If candidate WRITE is never read, sample_weight=0. Missing SKIP READ within the paired horizon is reported as censoring, not as sequence-wide absence.
utility: correct_duration - wrong_duration -0.5*switches -0.25*new_IDs -0.5*duplicate_collisions - identity_contamination - false_recovery_count +0.05*mean_reciprocal_rank_of_GT_target_queries -0.05*target_recovery_latency; latency censored atK+1 only when target queries exist; unrelated bank queries do not contribute rank reward.

memory_baselines.M2: latest10 bounded gallery with native reverse-order mean; should exactly equal M0 bank representation
memory_baselines.M4: confidence adaptive EMA, trust=clip((confidence-0.4)/0.6,0,1), old weight0.9+0.1*(1-trust)
memory_baselines.M6: learned JEV only eligible after informative labels; no value claim without beating M0-M5

amendment_before_any_counterfactual_labe: Shared event-triggered horizon avoids comparing unequal future lengths and avoids replaying SKIP until sequence end merely because its bank entry is intentionally absent. Trigger remains actual live WRITE-branch READ, not baseline categories or fixed H8. Identity target and rank/latency terms are declared before labels: editing a bank must assess that bank identity, and rank changes must refer to its GT target queries rather than background detections.
identity_target: fixed pre-intervention majority GT for the identity bank being edited; fallback current observation GT if no known bank identity. A current unmatched detection is not labeled false solely from missing GT; targets still require assessed future effects.
